title: Preselect Vs Select Events And Chrome
description: Separate preselect (rectangle/lasso drag) from committed select; preselect secondary = anchor minus preselect; preselectCancel on Escape; onPreselect/onPreselectCancel events in TS.
summary: Single source of truth for interaction chrome: selectionIds + preselection only. Text overlays use boardInteractionChromeStyleKey from that state (not stale node.selected). syncBoardScene no longer applies descriptor selected/highlighted; reapplies syncInteractionChrome after JSX sync. Play markers no longer pass selected/highlighted props. 76 Vitest + 76 Rust tests pass.
